## Plan: TinyMCE Modifier Assistance

Upgrade the existing pantoken-aware CodeMirror completion so it suggests real, separate RSCSS modifier tokens from the component already present in an HTML `class` attribute, and add a model-driven TinyMCE context toolbar for editing component-owned and global utility modifiers. Keep the generic `@pantoken/tinymce-codemirror` package model-agnostic; implement both pantoken-specific experiences in `@pantoken/tinymce` and reuse its merged cssdoc model.

**Steps**

### Phase 1 — Shared modifier model
1. Extend `renderers/tinymce/src/cssdoc/model.ts` with typed helpers that operate on the caller-supplied `CssDocEntry[]`: index entries by their simple class token, resolve the nearest known component/custom-component, and collect applicable modifiers.
2. Define the shared filtering contract: include canonical concrete component modifiers plus modifiers from utility entries marked `global`; exclude pattern placeholders, deprecated entries, aliases, and interaction-only classes. Deduplicate by class name, with the component-owned definition winning. Preserve each modifier’s source entry and `prop`/`value` so UIs can separate component groups from global utilities.
3. Group valued modifiers by `prop`; treat valueless modifiers as independent boolean options. Keep component groups first. Put global modifiers under a separate Utilities branch, grouped by utility entry and then property where needed, so the selected all-globals scope remains navigable.

### Phase 2 — CodeMirror HTML completion
4. Refactor `renderers/tinymce/src/codemirror/autocomplete.ts` to use the actual `options.model` and CodeMirror’s HTML syntax tree rather than a one-line regular expression. Resolve the enclosing `class` attribute across multiline markup and determine the active class token at the caret.
5. Preserve component/utility base-class completion after `instui-`, including hyphenated names. Add modifier completion for the real HTML form `class="instui-button -color-…"`: infer the component from another token in that same attribute, offer its canonical component modifiers after `-`, and offer global utility modifiers after `--`. Insert complete class tokens, show property/source and descriptions in completion details, and avoid suggesting modifiers already present.
6. Add `@codemirror/language` as an explicit renderer peer/dev dependency if the syntax-tree implementation imports it directly. Leave `plugins/tinymce/codemirror/src/index.ts` model-agnostic; it already accepts the renderer’s completion extension through `SourceTogglePluginOptions.extensions`.
7. Replace the fused-token autocomplete tests with behavior-level cases for separate modifiers, global utilities, hyphenated components, multiline attributes, duplicate suppression, and no completion outside a class attribute or without a known component context.

### Phase 3 — Visual editor context toolbar
8. Add a pure helper module under `renderers/tinymce/src/lib/` that walks from TinyMCE’s selected node to the nearest ancestor with a known component/custom-component class, stopping at the editor body. Return the target element and resolved model entry; do not edit a more distant ancestor when a nearer known component is nested inside it.
9. Add `registerComponentModifierToolbar(editor, model)` under `renderers/tinymce/src/lib/`, following `registerIconContextToolbar`: register one context toolbar menu button named Modifiers, predicate it on the nearest known component context, and position it on the selected component node.
10. Build the menu from the shared groups: component properties and boolean options first, then a Utilities nested branch. Show active values with checked/toggle menu items. Add a Default item to each valued property group; selecting it removes that property’s current modifier. Selecting a value atomically replaces other modifiers in the same source/property group. Boolean items toggle independently. Preserve unrelated classes and wrap every mutation in `editor.undoManager.transact()`.
11. Register the context toolbar from `createComponentsPlugin(options)` so both standalone component-picker use and the composed `createPantokenPlugin` receive it using the same supplied model. Keep icon pattern modifiers out because the existing icon picker/context toolbar owns glyph selection.
12. Add renderer strings for Modifiers, Utilities, Options, Default, and accessible tooltips/labels in `renderers/tinymce/src/i18n.json` and `renderers/tinymce/src/strings.ts`; run the repository i18n extraction/drift workflow for generated catalogs required by this package.
13. Add focused happy-dom tests for exact-node and nearest-ancestor detection, unknown nodes, menu grouping/filtering, current-state indicators, default removal, exclusive replacement, boolean toggling, global utility application, preservation of unrelated classes, and undo transactions. Extend `components-picker.test.ts` or the pantoken meta-plugin test to assert toolbar registration through the owning plugin.

### Phase 4 — Integration and release artifacts
14. Update the Canvas editor scaffold assertions to lock in the already-present completion wiring and new context-toolbar behavior through `createPantokenPlugin`; regenerate scaffold output only if the repository’s generator requires it.
15. Update the relevant TinyMCE/Canvas guide or renderer docs to describe separate-token completion and the visual Modifiers menu. Update the `@pantoken/tinymce` README/API surface if the new registration/helper is public; do not change the generic codemirror README except if its extension example needs clarification.
16. Add a changeset for the user-visible `@pantoken/tinymce` feature. Record no `@pantoken/tinymce-codemirror` release unless that package’s public API changes. Evaluate `ai/pantoken-ai`, `ASSURANCE.md`, and `SECURITY.md`; expected result is no edits because package recommendations, external input boundaries, and sanitization responsibilities do not change.

**Relevant files**
- `renderers/tinymce/src/cssdoc/model.ts` — shared supplied-model indexing, applicability, filtering, and grouping helpers.
- `renderers/tinymce/src/codemirror/autocomplete.ts` — syntax-aware class context and component/global modifier completion.
- `renderers/tinymce/src/lib/component-modifier-toolbar.ts` — new nearest-component resolver and context toolbar behavior.
- `renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/components.ts` — register the toolbar using `ComponentsPickerOptions.model`.
- `renderers/tinymce/src/lib/icon-context-toolbar.ts` — existing context-toolbar implementation to mirror, not otherwise change.
- `renderers/tinymce/src/index.ts` — export public helper/types only if consumers need them.
- `renderers/tinymce/src/i18n.json` and `renderers/tinymce/src/strings.ts` — localized UI labels.
- `renderers/tinymce/package.json` — explicit CodeMirror language dependency/peer if needed.
- `renderers/tinymce/tests/autocomplete.test.ts` — replace fused-token assumptions with real class-token scenarios.
- `renderers/tinymce/tests/component-modifier-toolbar.test.ts` — new resolver/menu/mutation coverage.
- `renderers/tinymce/tests/components-picker.test.ts` and/or `renderers/tinymce/tests/pantoken.test.ts` — plugin registration coverage.
- `packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl` — integration reference; completion extensions are already wired here.
- `packages/scaffold/tests/index.test.ts` — generated scaffold contract if integration assertions change.
- `docs/guide/canvas-rce.md` — user-facing editor behavior.
- `.changeset/*.md` — renderer release note.

**Verification**
1. Run focused renderer tests for autocomplete and component toolbar behavior with `vp test renderers/tinymce/tests/autocomplete.test.ts renderers/tinymce/tests/component-modifier-toolbar.test.ts`.
2. Run affected plugin/integration tests, including `vp test renderers/tinymce/tests/components-picker.test.ts renderers/tinymce/tests/pantoken.test.ts packages/scaffold/tests/index.test.ts`.
3. Run `vp check --fix`, then the package/repository checks required by the touched docs and i18n surfaces, including `check:drift`, `check:publish`, and `lint:markdown` through their existing `vp run` tasks.
4. Browser-verify the Canvas editor at desktop and mobile widths: component completion after `instui-`; component modifier completion after a separate `-`; global completion after `--`; multiline class attributes; toolbar appearance on a component and nested child; exclusive value replacement; Default removal; boolean toggles; Utilities submenu; undo/redo; no toolbar on ordinary content.
5. Run `vp test --coverage` last so `coverage-final.json` reflects all new/updated tests.

**Decisions**
- Include component-owned canonical modifiers and all canonical concrete global utilities.
- Edit the nearest known component ancestor when selection is inside nested markup.
- Provide a Default item per valued modifier group.
- Exclude deprecated aliases, pattern placeholders such as icon names, and interaction-only modifiers from the visual menu and contextual source suggestions.
- Keep `@pantoken/tinymce-codemirror` generic; pantoken metadata and UI remain owned by `@pantoken/tinymce`.
- Deliberately exclude a general-purpose arbitrary class editor, component insertion changes, and source-linter expansion beyond any helper reuse needed for completion.

## Plan: TinyMCE Modifier Assistance

Yes, both are feasible. The source editor already has pantoken completion wired in, but it currently assumes fused tokens like `instui-button-…` instead of real separate modifier classes. The visual editor already has an icon context-toolbar pattern we can reuse.

**Implementation**
1. Add shared model helpers in [renderers/tinymce/src/cssdoc/model.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/cssdoc/model.ts) to collect canonical component modifiers and global utilities, grouped by property.
2. Rewrite [autocomplete.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/codemirror/autocomplete.ts) to:
   - Understand multiline HTML using CodeMirror’s syntax tree.
   - Suggest components after `instui-`.
   - Suggest component modifiers after a separate `-`.
   - Suggest global utilities after `--`.
   - Support hyphenated component names and suppress duplicates.
3. Add a component modifier context toolbar under `renderers/tinymce/src/lib/`, following [icon-context-toolbar.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/lib/icon-context-toolbar.ts).
4. Resolve the nearest known component ancestor when the caret is inside nested markup.
5. Show one **Modifiers** dropdown:
   - Component groups such as Color, Size, and Shape first.
   - Boolean modifiers under Options.
   - Global modifiers under a nested Utilities menu.
   - A Default item for clearing each valued property.
6. Replace modifiers from the same property atomically, toggle boolean modifiers, preserve unrelated classes, and support undo/redo.
7. Register it through [components.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/components.ts), so the composed pantoken plugin receives it automatically.
8. Add localized labels, focused tests, documentation, and an `@pantoken/tinymce` changeset.

**Decisions**
- Include global utilities.
- Edit the nearest component ancestor.
- Use a Default item per modifier group.
- Exclude deprecated aliases, pattern placeholders, and interaction-only modifiers.
- Keep [plugins/tinymce/codemirror](plugins/tinymce/codemirror) generic and model-agnostic.

**Verification**
Run focused renderer and scaffold tests, browser-check source completion and toolbar behavior, run repository checks, then finish with `vp test --coverage`.

The complete implementation plan is saved in `/memories/session/plan.md`.
Start implementation

I’ll implement the shared modifier model and source completion first, validate that slice immediately, then add the TinyMCE context toolbar and integration. I’ll begin by checking the current worktree so I don’t collide with existing edits.
